scope: Construction of one explicitly selected steel Rozhnovsky water tower WT-ROZHNOVSKY-VBR50-18 with 50 m3 tank, 18 m support height, 620 m2 potable-water coating, 38 m DN150 riser and 22 m DN100 overflow pipe. Direct foundation, steel assembly, coating, piping, controls, electrical protection, labor, mechanisms, testing and logistics are project-owned.
sourceAuthority: Approved water-tower structural and hydraulic design, steel fabrication drawings, foundation and anchor schedule, piping-controls specification, coating system, geotechnical report, testing program, suppliers and approving project engineer
forbiddenClaims: village distribution network, trench, d110 pipe, valve chamber or fire hydrant scope
foundation, steelwork, piping, coating, labor, mechanism or logistics quantities derived from tower height or capacity
automatic excavation shoring, groundwater dewatering or road reinstatement
universal retained spare or supplier-package coverage
water intake, treatment plant, reservoir, sewer or invented price
